title: Match complete CI paths, including newline filenames
body:
## Summary

`check_selected_ci_inputs.py --require-triggers` could report `PASS_SELECTED_CI_INPUTS` for a required file named `supplier/proof.md\n` when the workflow only includes the literal path `supplier/proof.md`. Python's `$` accepts a position before the final newline. Conversely, the regex `.` excluded LF inside `**` and `**/`, rejecting valid coverage. GitHub's [workflow syntax](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#patterns-to-match-file-paths) requires the entire path to match and defines `**` to include any character.

Use strict `\A` / `\Z` anchors and `re.DOTALL`, preserving the supported glob grammar, slash restriction for `*`, ordered negations, and advisory default. Add ten matcher controls and twelve real CLI invocations with complete temporary source inventories and certificates, covering both event types and advisory/required modes. The LF filesystem cases are skipped on Windows, where these filenames are invalid; matcher tests run everywhere.

This is a narrow production correction based on canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. It changes neither the selected result nor frozen evidence. No missed hosted run or mathematical-construction failure is claimed.

## Test plan

- [x] Negative control before the production change: the two new tests failed in 16 subtests, including exit 0 / `PASS_SELECTED_CI_INPUTS` for the uncovered trailing-LF file on both events, and false failures for both globstar forms.
- [x] `python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_selected_ci_inputs.py -v` — all 26 tests passed.
- [x] `python3.12 -I -O -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_selected_ci_inputs.py -q` — all 26 tests passed under optimized execution.
- [x] `python3.12 -I -B scripts/check_selected_ci_inputs.py --require-triggers` — all 35 live pins and 1,635 required paths passed.
- [x] `python3.12 -I -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py` — selected record, exact kappa, original source inventory, and proof supplements passed.
- [x] `git diff --check`.
- [ ] Hosted GitHub Actions and the full selected cold replay were not run; this change only affects the static trigger-coverage matcher.

Tests ran on macOS arm64 using CPython 3.12.14. Initial full-module attempts identified missing files in the sparse checkout; after materializing the selected dependencies and proof supplements, the complete focused module passed in the isolated worktree.

## Attribution and overlap

Credit Sagar Thakrar's [original guard (#1361)](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1361), Nick Petalas's [ordered branch-filter repair (#2928)](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2928), and the retained selected-record and supplier authors. This addresses the newline/full-path mismatch separately from branch ordering. The complete overlap snapshot refreshed on 2026-10-18 covered 340 open PRs and 2,453 Discussions; live all-state PR searches and local notes identified these predecessors and no equivalent newline repair. Search coverage is limited to those records.

Prepared by roger-sato with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
